status: pre-registered (provisional until the Oct 28 statement diff; weights frozen before first scoring run)

monte_carlo.rule: A site is robust when its cell is in the top 5% of scorable land cells (cos(lat) area-weighted threshold, recomputed per draw; insufficient_data cells excluded) in >= 80% of the draws
monte_carlo.alpha_rule: alpha_i = dirichlet_alpha_scale * w_i / sum(w) over active (w > 0, not dropped) core factors; zero weights stay 0

variants.help: Every site is within 6 hours of a city of 50,000+ people.
variants.unavailable_reason: No portfolio has every site within 6 h of a city of 50k+.
variants.source: MAP travel time to the nearest city of 50k+ (Nelson et al. 2019), cell value

variants.pool_filter: same continent (the continent whose pool gives the best coverage; ties -> higher summed score)
variants.help: All sites on one continent, for a single expedition.
variants.unavailable_reason: No single continent covers {k} or more needs.
variants.source: Natural Earth admin-0 CONTINENT of the cell centre

defaults.percentiles: All Earth percentiles, the median used for the candidate pool, the P0.5/P99.5 clip and top-x% thresholds are cos(lat) area-weighted over land cells

missing_data.earth_nan: factor dropped for that cell, active weights renormalised
missing_data.below_min: insufficient_data (excluded from ranking, thresholds, pools and robustness)
missing_data.target_null: sampled in the pipeline; if still missing, dropped for that target with weights renormalised and listed in dropped_factors

mars.applies_to: every profile of a Mars target (P1-P5, including P5), after the land (water_frac < 0.5) and built-up (builtup_frac < 0.5) filters

clauses.B: barren_frac >= f8_min (bare/sparse + snow/ice, fraction of land pixels)
clauses.C: permafrost_frac >= pf_min && barren_frac + moss_lichen_frac >= f8_moss_min (polar / cold desert)
clauses.D: (geomorph_flags & d_flag_mask) != 0 && (aridity_index <= d_ai_max || barren_frac >= d_f8_min) (impact or Holocene volcanic, not massif)

mars.missing: aridity_index NaN fails A and the AI part of D; NaN barren/permafrost/moss/flags read as 0
mars.effect: acts as a hard filter for Mars targets: failing cells score S = 0 (like profile hard filters), so Earth percentiles, top-5%/top-1% thresholds, Monte Carlo robustness, candidates and validation percentiles are all computed after gating
mars.provenance: Researcher, docs/research.md §8 (2026-10-08). Designed after the first validation run, using the 15 Mars-relevant analogs and 11 negative controls in validation.csv, before the validation freeze; expected exception: Rio Tinto (sub-cell acid river in semi-arid woodland) fails and is reported as gate-excluded, not whitelisted
mars.ui_tooltip: For Mars, a site must be dry (aridity index 0.2 or less), at least half bare ground, a cold desert on permafrost, or an impact or young volcanic landscape that is not wet and green.
